title: 外倾低侧拉换重心
description: 彩铅中，侧拉大点与正向脚点帮助身体在低位横向转换。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: An original colored-pencil illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult shifting laterally on a low shallow overhang. One hand grips a broad orange sidepull, the other remains on a large rounded edge, and both feet press clear positive footholds near the continuous crash mat. The pelvis turns modestly toward the supporting foot to keep the body close without an exaggerated arch. Frame the full figure from an oblique medium-wide angle that reveals wall thickness and empty padded landing. Use grainy indigo pencil shadows, warm cream paper, and muted rust clothing. The movement is deliberate. No swinging feet, leaps, lettering, brands, dangerous height, or crowded landing zone.
